title: Bundled all-continuous scalar ring
statement: Let $F$ be a topological commutative ring with continuous ring operations, and choose a universe $\mathcal U$ containing $F$ and the profinite parameter sets. Take the continuous-map condensed ring of [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring], on $\operatorname{Profinite}_{\mathcal U}$ with the coherent topology and abelian coefficients in the next universe. Its sections at $S$ are the universe lift of $C(S,F)$, restrictions are precomposition, and ring operations are pointwise. Define its bundled commutative ring object $A_F$ in the category $\operatorname{Ring}$ of [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data] by taking this underlying abelian sheaf, its recorded canonical monoid-object structure, and its recorded commutativity witness. This merely bundles those three existing fields; it introduces no new sheaf or multiplication, no choice of an unspecified object, and no completeness, local-constancy, or finite-subextension condition.
